title: GPT-6.2 Sol Fully Launches on ChatGPT: It Can Clearly See Stop Signs and Will Even Proactively Remind You to Lower the Price
excerpt: OpenAI is iterating its models so fast this time that it feels almost ruthless. Less than a week after GPT-6.2Sol made its debut on the Work and Codex platforms
content_html:
OpenAI is iterating its models so fast this time that it feels almost ruthless. Less than a week after GPT-6.2Sol made its debut on the Work and Codex platforms, it officially moved into the ChatGPT chat page on November 24 and began rolling out to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers worldwide. As new users get started, the farewell dates for a batch of older models have also been set — some models in the GPT-5.6 series will officially go offline on December 23.

The upgrade approach for this version is clear: rather than competing over who has more parameters or stronger reasoning, it puts effort into everyday conversation scenarios. Visual recognition is the most obvious area. GPT-6.2Sol’s accuracy in identifying details in photos has clearly improved; it can even make out the tiny symbols on parking signs. In other words, the old awkwardness of “being able to read large text but having small text blur together” is gradually being erased.

The changes to web search are even closer to real-world use. OpenAI gave an example: when you ask the model to compare hotels for a weekend trip, it no longer just dumps search results in a list. Instead, it takes factors like walking distance and room rates into account and weighs the trade-offs for you — another step from “helping you search” toward “thinking for you.” The shopping scenario extends along the same line: when you have your eye on a product, the model will proactively offer to remind you when its price drops.

OpenAI sums up the focus of this update as letting AI understand users’ implicit needs and provide more proactive help during searching, comparing, and decision-making. Compared with a leap in capability, this kind of “reading the room” improvement is actually easier for people to notice in everyday use.

When new models come in, old models have to make room. According to the announced retirement schedule, GPT-5.6Sol will be fully taken offline from all three platforms — the ChatGPT chat page, Work, and Codex — on December 23; GPT-5.6Terra will leave ChatGPT Work and Codex on the same day. The cycle for a generation of models, from full rollout to honorable retirement, is being squeezed shorter and shorter by the company.
